notes: Evaluator-owned scope guidance for a source-only archive destination review. It contains no expected locations or answer-key labels.

vectors.title: Review archive destination boundaries
vectors.rationale: Archive-controlled names require a source-visible destination-boundary review before a write.

reviewObligations.riskStatement: An archive-controlled name may reach a write destination without source-visible containment control.
reviewObligations.evidenceRequirement: The review identifies the destination write and missing or ineffective containment condition.

limitations: Static review cannot establish archive-parser behavior outside this source scope.
